cve_description: xmltok_impl.c in Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.5 lacks certain validation of encoding, such as checks for whether a UTF-8 character is valid in a certain context.
patch:
--- code before
+++ code after
@@ -128,6 +128,10 @@
   case BT_LEAD##n:                                                             \
     if (end - ptr < n)                                                         \
       return XML_TOK_PARTIAL_CHAR;                                             \
+    if (IS_INVALID_CHAR(enc, ptr, n)) {                                        \
+      *nextTokPtr = ptr;                                                       \
+      return XML_TOK_INVALID;                                                  \
+    }                                                                          \
     if (IS_NMSTRT_CHAR(enc, ptr, n)) {                                         \
       ptr += n;                                                                \
       tok = XML_TOK_NAME;                                                      \
